_comment: Career-mode balance knobs. Loaded at startup over the compiled defaults (these ARE the defaults) — edit a value and relaunch, no rebuild. A removed field falls back to the built-in default. See docs/DATA_PIPELINE.md.
_finances_gate_receipts: per-match income factor from both teams' values; bigger mults = bigger gates
_finances_wages: trialist/reserve players cost that % of a full wage; wage_scale is the overall wage multiplier
_board_expectations: chairman verdict from league finish; ratio thresholds (higher = easier to please), percentile reward/punish, cup top-2 bonuses
_career_length: how many seasons before the manager retires; 20 (classic) or _up to 35
_capacities: list sizes (include/career_capacity.h): the original's at least, the SDL build's maximum at most (50000 / 45 / 10 / 20)
_trialists: 0 = count available players by the caller's flag, as the original; 1 = injured and suspended players out in every non-training match
_finances2: benefactorr's Career+ values in its own career_params.json: wage_pct 40, team_value_wage_pct 250, running_cost_mode 1 (halved, progressive brackets), running_cost_pct 45, league_gate_mult 100, sponsorship_mode 1 with sponsorship_weeks [18,14,10,6], league_distribution_weeks [9,7,5,3], profit_loss_sponsorship 1
_transfers: Career+'s: transfer_quota_mode 1 with transfer_quota 256 (half for sales, half for buys; buys then limited only by the pool's room), foreign_refill_mult 3, listed_bid_chance 36, foreign_bid_chance 64, domestic_buyer_mode 1
_job_offers: Career+'s: job_offer_expiry 0, job_offer_first_week 20, job_offer_waves 1, job_offer_stop_season7 0, job_offer_phase_gate 0, job_offer_own_national 0, job_offer_pass 220, job_offer_rep_high_pct 125, job_offer_rep_low_pct 55, job_offer_selector_clubs 96, job_offer_national_chance 192, job_offer_abroad_chance 128 (with job_offers_capacity 20)
